benchmark.description: Five previously unseen localization-heavy tasks over a new multi-package operations repository. The suite and its decision gate are frozen before the first live-model run.
benchmark.name: pico-repo-map-localization-v5-heldout

rows.final_answer: Updated ops_center/inventory/policy.py so reserve_stock uses the requested region’s priority list when present and falls back to default only when the region is absent, selecting the first warehouse with sufficient stock and preserving KeyError/ValueError behavior. Expanded tests in tests/test_inventory.py to cover regional selection, no fallback on insufficient regional stock, non-positive quantity, and unknown warehouse handling with unchanged state checks. Verified with PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_pricing.py (9 passed).

Updated scheduling cross-midnight handling in ops_center/scheduling/calendar.py so overnight windows treat the after-midnight segment as belonging to the previous configured start day, while preserving inclusive start and exclusive end semantics. Added scheduling tests for cross-midnight behavior, offset/week wraparound, invalid weekday/minute ValueError cases, and unknown service KeyError. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_pricing.py (10 passed).

Implemented discount selection in ops_center/pricing/discounts.py to pick the eligible rule with the smallest numeric priority while preserving original order on ties. Added pricing tests covering priority precedence, tie order, wildcard SKU, segment/min_qty eligibility, invalid percent, invalid quantity, unknown SKU, and input immutability. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_pricing.py tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_incidents.py (13 passed).

Updated rollout assignment scoping to use (tenant_id, user_id, flag_name) in ops_center/rollouts/store.py. Added rollouts tests covering tenant scoping, missing identifiers/flag errors, and invalid percentage behavior with no assignment mutation. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_pricing.py (8 passed).

Implemented transitive incident blocker validation in ops_center/incidents/dependencies.py, preserving the public resolve_incident API. Added incident tests for transitive open blockers, unknown blocker/target, dependency cycles, and already-resolved no-op behavior. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` passing: 10 passed.

Fixed inventory reserve flow in ops_center/inventory/policy.py to use region-specific priorities when present and default only when the region is absent, selecting the first warehouse with sufficient stock and preserving KeyError/ValueError behavior without fallback. Added inventory tests covering absent-region fallback, regional priority selection, no fallback on insufficient regional stock, non-positive quantity validation, and unknown warehouse IDs. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_pricing.py (9 passed).

Fixed scheduling maintenance-window evaluation for cross-midnight behavior in ops_center/scheduling/calendar.py and added/expanded scheduling coverage in tests/test_scheduling.py for daytime windows, cross-midnight windows, offset/week-wrap behavior, invalid inputs, unknown service, and unchanged windows. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q (9 passed).

Implemented pricing discount precedence in ops_center/pricing/discounts.py so eligible rules are filtered by sku/min_qty/segment and the selected rule is the eligible one with the smallest numeric priority, preserving original order on ties. Added pricing tests covering precedence, tie behavior, segment/min_qty eligibility, unknown SKU, invalid quantity, invalid percent_bps, and input immutability. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` -> 12 passed.

Updated rollout assignment scoping to use (tenant_id, user_id, flag_name) in ops_center/rollouts/store.py. Existing service logic already validated tenant_id, user_id, missing flags, and percentage bounds before persisting, so no service API changes were needed. Added rollout tests covering tenant scoping, missing identifiers, missing flag, and invalid percentage behavior. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` -> 9 passed.

Implemented transitive incident blocker validation in `ops_center/incidents/dependencies.py` with cycle detection, unknown blocker propagation, and unresolved blocker reporting. Kept public API unchanged. Added incident tests covering success, transitive open blockers, unknown target, unknown transitive blocker, dependency cycles, and already-resolved no-op. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` (10 passed).

Updated ops_center/inventory/policy.py so reserve_stock uses the requested region’s priority list when present, falls back only for absent regions, selects the first warehouse with sufficient stock, and preserves KeyError/ValueError behavior without mutating inputs on failure. Added inventory tests covering regional priority order, no fallback on insufficient regional stock, non-positive quantity, and unknown warehouse IDs. Verified with: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_pricing.py (9 passed).

Fixed scheduling maintenance-window evaluation for cross-midnight windows by updating `ops_center/scheduling/calendar.py` so after-midnight minutes are matched against the previous configured start day while preserving inclusive start/exclusive end semantics and leaving window data unchanged. Added scheduling tests covering daytime windows, cross-midnight behavior, offset/week wraparound, invalid weekday/minute errors, unknown service KeyError, and immutability. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_scheduling.py tests/test_inventory.py tests/test_incidents.py tests/test_rollouts.py tests/test_pricing.py` (12 passed).

Implemented discount selection in ops_center/pricing/discounts.py to choose the eligible rule with the smallest numeric priority while preserving original order on ties. Added pricing tests covering wildcard SKU, min_qty, segment matching, priority precedence, tie handling, no-match behavior, invalid quantity, invalid percent_bps, unknown SKU, and input immutability. Verification: PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_pricing.py -> 10 passed. Note: running the full suite as plain pytest -q failed at collection with ModuleNotFoundError: ops_center due to environment PYTHONPATH setup, not pricing logic.

Fixed rollout assignment scoping by changing the stored key to (tenant_id, user_id, flag_name). Added rollout tests covering tenant/flag scoping plus KeyError/ValueError validation with no assignment mutation on failure. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` -> 8 passed.

Implemented transitive incident dependency validation in `ops_center/incidents/dependencies.py` with cycle detection and unknown blocker propagation. Added incident tests covering direct/transitive open blockers, unknown target/blocker, cycles, success, and resolved no-op. Verified with `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` -> 11 passed.
